review_risks: branch and merge arrows must remain unambiguous after paper-size reduction
Chinese module titles must remain readable without reproducing the source figure's sparse labels
the compact genetic-algorithm note must not imply an extra branch absent from Figure 4-1
SVG/PDF text and vector structure must remain usable for manual editing
scientific_unknowns: The schematic does not assign a numerical unit to path length; this is intentionally omitted from the drawing.
The source text describes later model families, but the verified Figure 4-1 image does not draw them; they are excluded.
